name: WOKING ONE

specs.notes: McLaren's P1 (2013): a 3.8 twin-turbo V8 with an electric motor, 916 PS and 900 N m combined (727 hp and 720 N m from the V8 alone), a seven-speed dual clutch, 1,490 kg kerb (McLaren's 1,395 kg is dry; Motor Trend's test car 3,296 lb, 1,495 kg; before October 2026 it ran at the dry figure), 350 km/h limited, a 2,670 mm wheelbase. Its torque curve and aero are estimates. Its seven-speed's ratios are McLaren's (the P1 owner's handbook: 3.981 / 2.613 / 1.905 / 1.479 / 1.161 / 0.906 / 0.686 on a 3.308 final drive), with its 350 km/h limiter; before October 2026 a 4.61 final drive ran it into the rev limiter in seventh at 350 km/h.

garage.blurb: The hybrid hypercar that started it all: a V8 and an electric motor, 916 horsepower, and it hits like nothing else from 100 to 200.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel found by measurement (the hub's badge and stitching) and cut out to turn (tools/cars/mc_p1.json); the eye set from the 600's geometry. Handled as no-AI: checked by scripts only, its renders not viewed.
